name: GZServiceString(const char *) (ServiceStringObject::ConstructFromText: the MSVC basic_string constructor with the allocator-service allocator, ret 4, returns this)
notes: Hooked. Ours allocates through GZServiceAllocator (AllocateViaAllocatorService 0x1bf795, verified); the original through 0x177110 (the same cached-service slot 3 call with an _Init_thread_abort handler on first use): the only difference is the guard not being aborted if GetAllocatorService throws on first use.
